South Korea.title: FAE - Senior Field Applications Engineer (AI & Vision Specialist)

South Korea.description: Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc. People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the Aggregate System and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence. Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you. Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await! Job Description The Edge AI & Vision FAE delivers expert technical support to facilitate the integration of Microchip solutions and Hailo technologies into customer applications. Focusing on the Hailo NPU (Neural Processing Unit) and VPU (Vision Processing Unit) product portfolios, this role bridges deep learning model optimization with embedded Linux platforms to enable seamless AI acceleration on MPU and processor-based architectures. The candidate will leverage hands-on expertise in Linux driver porting, HailoRT runtime integration, and GStreamer-based video pipeline debugging to guide customers through complex system integration challenges. Working closely with global Business Unit (BU) teams, the Edge AI & Vision FAE will ensure the rapid resolution of field technical issues and customer requirements. Additionally, this role serves as a key voice of the customer, delivering strategic market feedback to expand Microchip’s technology leadership and business presence in the rapidly growing Edge AI market. Job Responsibilities Hailo NPU Software Technical Support: Support customers with quantization, compilation, and optimization of deep learning models such as YOLO, ResNet, and Transformer-based models using the Hailo Dataflow Compiler and HailoRT runtime libraries. AI Acceleration Performance Optimization: Leverage the unique Dataflow Architecture of Hailo NPU to guide customers in achieving optimal frame rates (FPS) and memory bandwidth with minimum power consumption on their target platforms. VPU / Vision Processing Technical Support: Support customer applications based on VPU (Vision Processing Unit) and vision/video processing solutions, including system integration and performance optimization for AI and vision applications. Embedded Linux System Integration: Support Hailo NPU/VPU driver porting and integration in embedded Linux environments, including Kernel and Yocto, and resolve hardware/software integration issues involving PCIe or USB interfaces. Key Customer Technical Workshops and Seminars: Provide technical support for key customer workshops, seminars, and technical demonstrations. Requirements/Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. At least 2 years of professional experience in embedded systems, Edge AI, AI hardware, VPU/Vision Processing, or related development and technical support. Experience in developing or supporting AI, computer vision, or AI acceleration solutions is preferred. Ability to understand English technical documentation and communicate effectively with HQ engineers and global technical teams. Strong customer-facing, communication, and technical presentation skills. Preferred Qualifications NPU / AI Accelerator Ecosystem Experience Hands-on experience with third-party AI accelerator platforms such as NVIDIA TensorRT / DeepStream or Intel OpenVINO. Practical experience using SDKs from Korean NPU companies. Media Processing Experience Experience designing GStreamer pipelines and developing custom plugins, or practical experience with OpenCV / FFmpeg. Experience optimizing video processing pipelines to convert output data from media codecs such as H.264 and H.265/HEVC into input tensors for NPU processing. Global Collaboration Experience Experience collaborating with global HQ or overseas engineering teams. Experience supporting multiple customers and working effectively across teams. Strong English technical writing and communication skills. Competency Strategic/Critical Thinking—Systematically solves problems and hypothesizes possible client pain points, expectations, and implicit needs; brainstorms with team members to devise solutions to solve complex client challenges. Communication—Tailor communication to the client’s needs with authority; effectively delivers presentations and has strong verbal and written communication skills. Ownership—Goes out of his or her way to complete a task and has relentless drive to achieve results; is independent and self-directed and takes initiative. Benefits Microchip’s non-commissioned total compensation and benefits package includes a competitive base salary, bonus aligned with company goals, employee stock purchase program, health insurance coverage, etc. Opportunity to manage technical projects at accounts on an entrepreneurial and collaborative basis. Please do not forward resumes to our recruiting team or other Microchip employees. Microchip is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

South Korea.title: Senior Embedded AI Engineer
South Korea.description: At Sonatus, we're driving the transformation to AI-enabled software-defined vehicles. Traditional automotive software methods can't keep pace with consumer expectations shaped by the mobile industry—where features evolve rapidly, update seamlessly, and improve continuously. That's why leading OEMs trust Sonatus to accelerate this shift. Our technology is already in production across more than 9 million vehicles on the road today and rapidly expanding. Headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA, with 250+ employees worldwide, Sonatus combines the agility of a fast-growing company with the scale and impact of an established partner. Backed by strong funding and proven by global deployment, we're solving some of the most interesting and complex challenges in the industry. Join us and help redefine what's possible as we shape the future of mobility. Sonatus is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California with international locations in Ireland, France, Germany, Poland, Korea, China, India, Taiwan and Japan. This is a hybrid position at our Pangyo location. You will report to the Engineering Director. About the Role Sonatus is bringing production-grade AI to the vehicle edge with Fastlane™ Edge , the in-vehicle AI runtime that lets OEMs deploy, run, monitor and update AI models, virtual sensors and diagnostic logic on existing vehicle computers. Our Customer Success organization operates as Mission-Driven Squads that take full end-to-end ownership of a module, from implementation to verification to on-site support. We are looking for an Embedded AI Engineer to join our Korea Customer Success team and put edge AI into our Korean OEM programs. You will bring up the Fastlane Edge runtime on customer hardware, onboard AI models authored by partners, by the customer and by Sonatus, help customer engineers author their own models with the Sonatus SDK, validate models on real vehicles, and tune Sonatus in-house virtual-sensor models on customer data using our MLOps toolchain. You will act as a technical contact for the customer on edge AI integration topics. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who is comfortable in a Python training pipeline, inside a Linux container on an automotive ECU, and in a vehicle at a customer test site. Model development is part of the job, but always in service of a customer deliverable. Duties and Responsibilities Edge AI Runtime Integration on Customer Hardware Hardware Bring-Up : Bring up and maintain Fastlane Edge on customer targets — Sonatus gateway units (Fastlane Copilot) and customer control units — including CAN/CAN-FD bring-up, DBC/ARXML integration, sandbox and Python-runtime deployment, security-policy adjustments and cloud connectivity. SDK Integration : Integrate the runtime with customer platforms via the Sonatus Southbound SDK where direct bus access is not available. Runbook Ownership : Maintain the Korea integration runbooks and default configurations; work with the platform team to turn one-off demo fixes into mergeable, released code. AI Model Onboarding and Validation Model Packaging : Validate, package and deploy AI model bundles from partners, from customer engineers and from Sonatus using the Sonatus ADK: input-signal mapping, sampling and output schema review, dependency checks, resource budgets and OTA deployment through the Sonatus Cloud. Concurrency Verification : Verify multi-model concurrency on a single ECU within agreed CPU/RAM envelopes; measure and document per-model resource profiles and telemetry policies. Native Porting & Optimization : Migrate Python-developed models to production-ready native (C++/ONNX Runtime) bundles, including model conversion, native integration and optimization, with automated numerical-parity validation against reference implementations. Customer Enablement Training & Office Hours : Deliver SDK/ADK training and office hours in Korean for customer engineers authoring their own models; support model-contract (config.yml) authoring and signal-to-input mapping from customer network databases. Requirements Capture : Help capture customer AI workload requirements (use case, signals, rates, accuracy/latency targets, resource and data-sovereignty constraints) and document them for Sonatus product teams. Documentation as Code : Treat documentation as code: integration guides, troubleshooting FAQs and release notes in Korean and English. Model Development and Tuning on Customer Data MLOps Toolchain : Run customer vehicle captures through the Sonatus MLOps toolchain: data ingest and alignment, recipe-driven training, model-family A/B comparison (gradient boosting, temporal convolutional and physics-informed models), ONNX export, quantization and on-target latency measurement. Virtual-Sensor Tuning : Tune Sonatus virtual-sensor and estimation models on customer drives and deliver them as validated bundles with customer-facing reports. Ground Truth & Datasets : Define ground-truth capture (reference sensors, co-logging) and dataset versioning; contribute fixes and hardening upstream to the toolchain. On-Vehicle Validation, Demos and Customer Support Validation Drives : Execute on-vehicle validation and comparison drives; contribute to acceptance criteria and shadow-mode protocols with the customer and Sonatus QA; produce traceable test evidence and, where required, ASPICE v4 MLE artifacts. On-Site Support : Support major test events and demos on-site, troubleshooting integration issues directly in the vehicle or on the bench. Defect Triage : Act as a technical contact for edge AI integration issues; reproduce, isolate (bundle vs. runtime vs. cloud), and follow customer-found defects through the Sonatus release train. AI-Augmented Workflow AI Tooling : Leverage AI tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot to accelerate recipe authoring, test generation, log analysis and documentation, within customer data-governance constraints. Qualifications and Experience [Essential Background] Education : Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical/Control Engineering or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Experience : 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or embedded software, including 2+ years deploying ML models on edge or embedded Linux targets. Customer-facing integration, field application or solutions engineering experience is a strong plus. Languages & Systems : Strong Python; ability to read, build and debug modern C++ (C++14/17); solid Linux debugging skills (systemd, processes and logs, containers; exposure to cgroups, sandboxing, seccomp or shared-library/glibc issues is a plus). [Core Competencies] Structured Device/Signal Data : Hands-on experience working with structured device or bus-level signal data — automotive (CAN/CAN-FD), industrial fieldbus, or similar — including signal mapping, sampling and time alignment. Familiarity with automotive-specific protocols (DBC/ARXML, UDS, SOME/IP, DLT) is a plus, not a prerequisite. ML Deployment : ML deployment experience with ONNX/ONNX Runtime and PyTorch or scikit-learn/XGBoost; exposure to quantization and latency/memory profiling on ARM (aarch64) targets. Applied Modeling : Applied modeling experience with time-series or vehicle-signal data (regression, estimation or anomaly detection) and the ability to evaluate models against agreed metrics. ML Pipelines & Data Tooling : Experience with reproducible ML pipelines and data tooling such as Parquet, Apache Arrow or DuckDB, experiment tracking and versioned datasets. Verification Mindset : Python test automation and evidence-based triage; willingness to split time between development and validation as the mission requires. Communication : Fluent Korean and professional English; clear technical writing and comfort supporting customer engineers and on-site test events. Collaboration : Results-driven, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with customer and internal teams. Preferred Knowledge and Experience Platform Experience : Hands-on experience with NXP S32 family / eIQ Auto, Qualcomm SA8xxx / SNPE-QNN, or comparable embedded compute platforms. Vehicle Dynamics : Vehicle dynamics, chassis or body control-domain knowledge; prior virtual-sensor or sensor-replacement work. OEM IT & Security Stacks : Familiarity with OEM IT and security stacks (Kubernetes, Harbor/Nexus, Kafka, SonarQube/Blackduck, security review processes) and data-sovereignty requirements. Standards Awareness : Awareness of ASPICE v4 (Machine Learning Engineering process group), ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 as applied to ML components. LLM-Assisted Engineering : Experience with LLM-assisted engineering workflows (agent tooling, MCP) and evaluation. Tooling & Process : Proficiency with Jira/Confluence, Git-based workflows, and Agile/Scrum in cross-functional squads. Korea Office Benefits & Perks Offered: Point Reward Program for Customer Integration team Support 4 social insurance plans Family leave (Maternity, Paternity) Hybrid office work-arrangement Complimentary lunches, snacks and beverages during on-site working days Wellness benefit allowance Phone & Internet reimbursement Computer Accessory Allowance English Support class Annual health checkup Holiday Appreciation Gift

Experience in cellular modem platforms and data connectivity solutions. Focusing on security and reliability, the company delivers award-winning IoT solutions, modules, and services trusted by top global brands. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact You'll architect distributed payment systems at global scale, designing and evolving core infrastructure across real-time local clearing, SWIFT, and proprietary treasury routing in 150+ countries. Architect distributed payment systems at global scale, designing and evolving core infrastructure across real-time local clearing, SWIFT, and proprietary treasury routing in 150+ countries. Solve complex financial integrity problems by building idempotent, fault-tolerant systems for multi-currency reconciliation, asynchronous settlement, and compensation logic across unreliable banking partners. Own the reliability and observability of the payment network by defining SLAs, designing for graceful degradation during partner outages, and building real-time payment health monitoring. Use payment telemetry to optimise routing, identify bottlenecks, and measure how infrastructure changes affect settlement speed and conversion. Set technical direction across a distributed engineering team by leading design reviews for platform-wide changes, collaborating with engineering hubs across the US, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Shanghai. You'll work from our Seoul office five days a week. What we're looking for Essentials 7+ years’ experience building and operating production software, including distributed systems at scale. Strong system architecture skills, with practical experience designing for fault tolerance, idempotency, asynchronous workflows, reconciliation, settlement, and failure recovery. Experience owning reliability for critical systems, including defining SLAs, designing graceful degradation, building observability, and leading incident response. Strong programming or scripting skills in a language such as Java, Kotlin, C++, Python or a similar language. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Experience setting technical direction across multiple teams through design reviews, RFCs, and architecture decisions. Strong analytical skills, using operational and product data to guide technical decisions. Preferred Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated financial domains. Deep experience with JVM-based ecosystems, including Java or Kotlin with Spring or Spring Boot. Prior experience leading teams responsible for high-availability, low-latency systems. You'll thrive here if You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones. You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team. You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team's direction once a call is made. Learn more about your team The Global Treasury and Payment Network (GTPN) team sits at the heart of Airwallex’s payment infrastructure. As one of our foundational businesses and a major contributor to our growth, we build and operate the core treasury and payment infrastructure that powers our global financial products. We operate at the intersection of global financial infrastructure and modern product innovation, expanding the reach and capabilities of our treasury and payment network, strengthening reliability and resilience, and building innovative payment products at global scale. We’re a distributed engineering team, with talented engineers across established and emerging hubs around the world. As we continue to expand, you’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to build and evolve products and platforms that solve complex financial problems and support businesses around the world. South Korea.title: Principal Engineer - Automation
South Korea.description: Recruitment Fraud Alert We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number. What To Know Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text. We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day. Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee. If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com About Commvault Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. About The Team The Automation team at Clumio (Commvault) works closely with the backend team to help build and validate a cloud-scale SaaS backup platform that helps enterprises meet their cloud data protection needs. For many customers, backup is not a “nice-to-have” — it is a mandatory foundation driven by compliance, audit, and security requirements, where recovery speed, cost efficiency, and the ability to handle large-scale data are critical differentiators in real-world environments. Our systems protect and recover large volumes of cloud object data in a cloud-native way. Compared to native cloud backup solutions, we deliver up to 10× faster recovery times, roughly half the cost for S3 workloads, and the ability to reliably support significantly larger data scales. These outcomes come from deliberate engineering decisions across system architecture, data flows, and failure-handling strategies. The platform is designed to gracefully handle and recover from failures through reprocessing and retries, while maintaining correctness and reliability at scale. The team operates a proven platform built on Amazon S3 and DynamoDB and is now expanding into multi-cloud data protection across GCP and Azure — an opportunity to apply and evolve our approach across diverse cloud ecosystems. Beyond our SaaS solutions, we are also building AI agents that help our customers get more value from their data and operations. As a team, we embrace modern engineering practices, including agentic AI-assisted coding, to build and ship faster — and you will help shape how we adopt and scale these tools and techniques. Role Overview As a Principal Engineer on the Automation team, you will set the technical direction for how we validate and harden Clumio’s best-in-class SaaS platform for data protection in the public cloud. You are a hands-on technical leader who designs large-scale automation architecture, raises the engineering quality bar across the team, and mentors engineers at all levels. You will partner closely with Development, Product Management, and Customer Success leadership to anticipate risk, shape strategy, and ensure the platform performs reliably at scale and across multi-cloud environments. Our automation is built primarily in Python and interacts with and manipulates AWS infrastructure that simulates customer environments, involving services such as EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, SQS, SNS, VPC, CloudFormation, Lambda, Kubernetes, and Docker. As a Principal Engineer, you will architect the next generation of our data-generation tools, scale-test environments, and REST API libraries, and lead our adoption of agentic AI-assisted coding and AI agents across the team. What You’ll Do Own and drive the technical vision and architecture for automation across the platform. Design and build large-scale automation frameworks, tools, and scale-test environments. Lead the design and implementation of end-to-end integration, load, and stress tests for backup and restore across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Set and evangelize best practices in testing, automation, and product quality across multiple teams. Drive adoption of agentic AI-assisted coding and AI agents to accelerate how the team builds and ships. Partner with Development, Product Management, and Customer Success leadership on strategy, risk, and customer escalations. Mentor and grow engineers through design discussions, code reviews, and technical coaching. Influence cross-team technical decisions and align implementations with the broader engineering direction. Qualifications 8+ years of industry experience designing and building automation and/or test frameworks for large-scale production systems. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Deep expertise in Python or Go and in designing scalable, maintainable automation architecture. Proven track record as a hands-on technical leader who has set direction and raised the quality bar across teams. Strong experience with public cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native system design. Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions across an organization. Working knowledge of English. Note :Applicants must have valid authorization to work in South Korea. Commvault does not provide visa sponsorship for this role Nice to Have Hands-on experience with Docker and container orchestration such as Kubernetes. Experience building or operating cloud data protection, backup, or large-scale storage systems. Familiarity with agentic AI-assisted coding tools and building AI agents. You’ll Love Working Here Because… You’ll collaborate with amazing, driven, and supportive teammates. You’ll shape the technical direction of high-impact, large-scale cloud data protection systems used by global enterprises. You’ll enjoy continuous professional growth through development programs and clear career pathways. You’ll thrive in an inclusive, open culture with opportunities to connect through our Community Guilds. You’ll receive generous global benefits designed to support your well-being. You’ll earn competitive compensation that reflects your impact. You’ll share in our success through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Note :Applicants must have valid authorization to work in South Korea. France.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
France.description: Context Two video surveillance products are entering development at Vizzia: video-based traffic enforcement, with a first deployment in the UK, and ANPR, automatic number plate recognition run on legal request. Both rely on the same technical chain: camera-equipped units in the field, an edge to cloud pipeline, and a SaaS that officers use every day. That chain has to be built. Vizzia equips more than 250 local authorities for waste management today. Safety is the company's second product line, and it comes with its own constraints: data hosted in France on SecNumCloud infrastructure, evidential integrity, end to end traceability. The team is small and senior. You will join Jérémy Fornarino, Tech Lead, as the second backend engineer on Safety. Your mission: take ownership of a significant share of the backend for both products, across the full edge and cloud spectrum, and raise the team's quality bar alongside him. What You'll Do The edge backend Build and operate the services running on the field units: camera communication (VAPIX, ISAPI, ONVIF), NX Witness integration, local SQLite storage. Optimise CPU and RAM on units with limited resources, and minimise the 4G/5G bandwidth of the video chain without degrading the user experience. Debug a unit in production: SSH, logs, incident triage across the fleet. The cloud backend Design and operate the Hono APIs, the event-driven workers on the LavinMQ bus, and the Postgres/Drizzle data layer. Drive the fleet from the cloud, orchestrate processing, and guarantee resynchronisation after a network outage with no data loss. Deploy and operate: GitHub Actions, Helm, GKE, Datadog monitoring and alerting. Ship enforcement and ANPR to production Co-own both projects from technical spec through to production, working with the PM and the legal constraints of the domain: evidential integrity, audit trail, retention and purge, GDPR. Architect the shared ingestion and edge to cloud layer that both products converge on. Be one of the two backend leads on production incidents, able to handle an edge or cloud incident on your own. Architecture and quality Write your own ADRs, challenge Jérémy's, and be challenged in return. Ship every module tested, harden the critical parts of the existing code (workers, pipelines), and let CI catch regressions rather than customers. Keep to the monorepo conventions: moon, bun, ten bounded contexts. Current stack: TypeScript end to end, bun, Hono, Drizzle, Postgres on the cloud side, SQLite on the edge, LavinMQ bus, moon monorepo, GKE, Datadog. Infrastructure and DevOps experience is welcome but not a prerequisite, you can pick it up here. Who You Are 4 to 8 years of backend experience, a significant part of it in SaaS. TypeScript/Node in production, operational from day one. The rest of the stack is quick to learn on a solid foundation. You have built and operated event-driven distributed systems in production: message buses, workers, idempotency, retries, with the structured logging, monitoring and incidents that come with them. An engineering degree or a master's. French and English full working proficiency Curiosity about systems, networks and protocols. An unusual camera protocol or a unit stuck in a crashloop is the fun part of the job for you, not the scary one. AI coding tools are part of how you work, and the quality holds up. Two bonus profiles, not prerequisites: video and streaming experience (codecs, containers, VMS), or a background in IoT, embedded or robotics. Domain knowledge can make up for a shorter SaaS track record. At Vizzia we work in a small team, with a lot of ownership and few silos. We are looking for someone who picks up topics without waiting, argues their choices, and genuinely cares about the problems the public sector is trying to solve. Hiring Process Screening with Talent Acquisition - 30' Hiring Manager Interview - 1h Backend technical test - 1h [HQ/on-site] Team meeting & Final fit with VP Engineering - 2h Referrals Offer Compensation & Benefits 💶 65–75K€ fixed + bonus 🏡 Hybrid work 🏝 Contrat cadre and RTT (between 8 and 12 days per year depending on public holidays) 💻 Work Macbook 💸 BSPCE 🍜 60% coverage of meal vouchers worth €9 per worked day 🚃/🚲 Sustainable mobility allowance 🏥 Mutuelle (Alan) 💼 Offices located in central Paris (9th arrondissement) ☀️ Annual offsite with the whole team and plenty of company events If you've read this far, you're probably very interested in the role and/or Vizzia. We'd like to hear from you even if you feel you don't check every box.

France.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Integrations
France.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. About The Role You'll join the Integrations team, the connective tissue of Vibe's platform, reporting to the Engineering Manager. The team owns everything flowing in and out of Vibe: measurement and attribution integrations, audience connections from CRMs and CDPs, and reporting pipelines. This role exists because we're building a first-class Developer Platform: opening Vibe's full capabilities as a public API so external partners can build on top of us. Criteo is the first partner live on it. Three Reasons To Want This You'll be one of the most senior engineers on Integrations, setting technical direction for a team that's still small enough for one person's decisions to shape it You'll own the foundational architecture for a platform external partners are already building against AI-augmented development is the expectation here, not the experiment What You'll Do Build and ship integrations Design and implement production-grade integrations with external platforms: CRMs, CDPs, measurement vendors, data partners Own integration projects end to end, from scoping through production, with full accountability for outcomes Work directly with external partners to define, validate, and evolve data contracts Developer Platform Drive the architecture of Vibe's public API: account, advertiser, and campaign management endpoints built to scale Build the documentation, monitoring, and tooling that makes the developer experience genuinely good Contribute to the MCP gateway and authentication layers that expose Vibe's capabilities externally Reliability and scale Find the weak points in existing pipelines and lead the rebuild Set the standard for code quality on the team: your reviews move the bar, not just the diff Use AI tooling to accelerate your own output and raise the team's Technical leadership Set engineering norms and technical direction as the Integrations team grows Weigh in on architecture decisions across the team, not just your own projects Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical direction and hiring calibration What You Need Production backend TypeScript experience is required. You've built, shipped, and operated backend services, APIs, or microservices using TypeScript and Node.js, or a similar TypeScript backend runtime. Backend-leaning work. At least half your recent work is services, APIs, data models, and integrations. Fullstack is fine if the backend side is real. You build for users. You've shipped features customers or partners actually use. You've worked with product on what to build, pushed back on scope, and changed course when feedback came in. Ownership you can point to. A project you took from scoping to production and stayed accountable for after launch. AWS, with real architecture calls. Not just deploying to it. Nice to Haves Third-party integrations: ETL, webhooks, REST/GraphQL APIs, or similar Additional backend languages: Python, C++, Rust, or similar Developer-facing platforms: Experience designing or contributing to public APIs or developer platforms Startup experience: Current or past experience at a startup of ~300 people or fewer. Doesn't need to be your most recent role. Our Values At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. What We Offer At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up: The pay range for this role is €99,000–€133,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. Variable pay. Based on real Vibe business goals. Hybrid flexibility. We're in the heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week. Health insurance. Full coverage via Alan. Meal vouchers via Swile. Annual offsite. The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. Tech Syncs. Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. Our Interview Process We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect: no surprises, no ghosting. Recruiter screen. 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours. Manager Interview. 45 min with your future manager. Your experience, your projects, your approach. Product Interview. 30 mins with the Product Manager for this team. We want to hear about how you've worked cross-functionally in previous roles. Technical assessment. 90 min. Code review exercise plus applied questions. Real problems, not tricks. Bar raiser. 30 min with a senior leader to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar. Offer. Fast. We don't let good decisions sit. Equal Opportunity Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. Referral Instructions Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

France.title: Senior Software Engineer
France.description: About Teads Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform building the future of digital advertising where quality content, trusted publishers, ambitious brands, and human creativity can thrive. Operating at true scale - processing 18 billion ad opportunities every single day - we connect global brands with a monthly reach of over 2.2 billion unique users. At Teads, we believe your impact travels further . We are a borderless team of 1,700+ innovators across 30+ countries who favor outcome over tenure, value trusted autonomy, and use predictive AI to amplify human ingenuity rather than replace it. We move at pace, tackle genuinely complex problems, and foster a high-accountability culture that stays genuinely human. If you are looking for room to build and meaningful scope, you belong here. Learn more at www.teads.com. Our main Engineering challenges at Teads Build efficient and easy-to-use web products used by thousands of users working for the world’s most premium publishers, advertisers, and agencies. Rich and diverse tech stack and system architecture to optimize for performance, scalability, resiliency, and cost efficiency. We use mostly Scala and TypeScript, among others. Working in a very high-traffic environment (2.2 billion users per month, 100 billion events per day) with low latency and high availability constraints (2 million requests per second, responses in less than 150 milliseconds). Management of large datasets with milliseconds order of magnitude access time, to compute in a near real-time complex auction resolution algorithm (18 million predictions per second). A fast-changing environment where we continuously collaborate with Product teams and constantly adapt our Cloud infrastructure for new features and Products. Bring a wide diversity of profiles to the same level of quality and knowledge Work in an international environment with offices located in Israel, Slovenia and France. What will you do? As a Senior Software Engineer , your mission will be to: Collaborate with software engineers and data scientists to research, develop, and deploy experiments, features and enhancements with a high impact on our global revenue. Create, design, develop, test, and monitor your code in production autonomously and reliably. Work with the Engineering Manager, Product Manager and other teams to frame projects and be accountable for their execution. Obtain a good understanding of the business to provide relevant solutions to clients. Be a work facilitator and help communication inside and outside Teads. Stay up-to-date on new technologies and architectures. If they can solve a problem Teads has, propose ways to implement them into our current software engineering process. What will you bring to the team? Good programming abilities. Testing your code is second nature to you. You are mindful of your application’s architecture, performance, maintainability, and overall quality. Familiarity with large, high-throughput, distributed systems, and connecting together and processing large amounts of data Analytical and experimental mindset in any feature or project you’ll ship to production. You like to prove an idea first before you invest large amounts of effort into development. Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively within a diverse global team. You are an active listener and a dialogue facilitator, you know how to explain your decision and like sharing your knowledge. Multiple shipped projects in Software Engineering. Production knowledge and practices (Release, Observability, Troubleshooting…), thanks to multiple shipped projects / applications. Strong problem-solving skills. Please submit your CV in English. Life at Teads At Teads, we don’t just offer jobs. We blend creativity, technology, and cutting-edge data to shape the future of media. As a Teadster, you’ll work alongside smart humans, collaborate with meaningful brands, and leverage advanced AI and automation to redefine how advertising works in a transparent, privacy-first world. We are builders, innovators, and future-thinkers. If you are excited by the evolution of technology and ready to embrace the future of AI-driven media, you belong here. Why Join Us? A New Era of Media: We’ve merged two open internet category leaders, Outbrain and Teads to create a unified omnichannel platform. Together, we drive results from branding to performance across CTV, mobile, and web. AI-Powered Innovation: We actively embrace AI and next-gen technology to solve complex industry challenges. We look for curious minds who aren't afraid to experiment, adapt, and lead the charge into the future of digital advertising. Growth & High Performance: Our culture is dynamic, global, and built on excellence. We are committed to your success, offering the modern tools, mentorship, and development opportunities you need to thrive. Belonging & Impact: We foster a welcoming, diverse environment where approachable, resourceful, and passionate people excel. Through our employee-led Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), you can actively drive change in areas like sustainability, women’s empowerment, charitable initiatives, and DE&I. Equal Opportunity Employer Teads is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion at all stages of recruitment and employment. We celebrate unique perspectives and are dedicated to building a team that reflects the global communities we serve.

France.title: Principal Software Engineer– AI Networking
France.industries: Semiconductor Manufacturing, Software Development, and Computer Hardware Manufacturing
France.description: Job Overview The Software (CE-SW) group is responsible for developing and improving the software ecosystem around Arm's next generation architectures and systems. This means working with processors and other hardware technology not yet available to the public. You will join a team of Software Engineers who share a passion for leaving their mark on the future of computing. We are looking for an accomplished Software Engineer with a deep knowledge of developing high-performance networking software to be leveraged by AI frameworks. The successful candidate will be working with vibrant software and hardware teams across multiple geographies on ground-breaking products and will be presented with opportunities to vastly grow their technical understanding. If you are similarly passionate about innovative technologies, then we would love to hear from you! Responsibilities As a Principal Software Engineer in Infrastructure Application Solutions team, you will be working on the networking software stack for AI applications. You will be owning the product technical architecture and delivery. The responsibilities include: Driving overall system architecture and design of all individual components of AI NW software stack to ensure flawless operation of the entire product on Arm platform. Benchmarking, analyzing and optimizing the network software stack to provide best performance on Arm platform for running AI workloads. Working with open-source communities and key global partners to craft and release key software components aligned with Arm architecture. Collaborate with partners and customers across the globe to build and deliver high quality networking software stacks for Arm platform. Required Skills and Experience: A Candidate Should Have a deep understanding of the requirements and functionalities of high-performance networking software and proven experience in leading software product delivery. Have an outstanding grasp of computer architecture and operating systems and in-depth knowledge of data structures, algorithms and multi-core programming. Be highly proficient in C and C++ to the extent where they can write and debug complex software as well as guide and assist others to do the same. Be motivated to accept a variety of responsibilities in contributing to Arm’s success and capable of inspiring and mentoring junior members of the team. Have excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to generate consistent, complete and concise written specifications. “Nice To Have” Skills and Experience: The Following Experience Will Be Looked Upon Favourably Experience with open-source software contribution processes. Hands on development experience with high performance networking software, including areas such as Linux kernel networking, NIC drivers, DPDK PMDs, VPP, AF_XDP and kernel bypass. Experience with networking software stack components for AI applications such as RoCE, libFabric, OpenMPI, Gloo, NCCL, OneCCL, etc. Familiar with PyTorch based training applications or concepts related to SDN and cloud native technologies such as Kubernetes and CNIs. In Return: You'll enjoy a flexible work environment that supports work-life balance, and be part of an innovative team working on cutting-edge technology. Our offices are designed to foster creativity and teamwork, and we welcome versatile individuals who are eager to grow and become recognized experts within our team. Join us and thrive in a diverse and inclusive culture that values your contributions and celebrates your success. Salary Range €101,700 - €137,700 per year Our 10x Mindset At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible.
